snippet.title: Mantlebound Steam Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Get the demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5064550/Mantlebound/

Mantlebound is a fast-paced, top-down dash-fest with only one button to attack, yet different kind of attacks when unlocking abilities.

Dash through a beautiful futuristic fantasy world. Control the battlefield with precise movement and kiting enemies to get the maximum impact with your perfectly timed dash attacks. Collect orbs and upgrade Schnell's abilities to dominate every fight.

Step into the role of Schnell the Earth’s last protector… or destroyer.
